title: 第21章 炼器任务第22章 古怪周长老
lines: 至于紫阳剑法，或许因为没有紫阳剑配套练习之故，至今他仍未摸到门槛。
闭门造车始终不是办法，是应该出去看看了。
而且田氏在宗门的势力不小，李卓阳也想到别处打听一下田家的动向，以免措手不及。
他虽然当场就将二人挫骨扬灰了，可是由于当日走得急，田持弓身死之地还残留不少痕迹，若是田家仔细探查，说不定还能找出一些蛛丝马迹。
出了杂货铺后，李卓阳果然发现总内坊市间，人少了很多，而且有几位身着玄袍的内门弟子，在不断地打量着坊市内所有人。
李卓阳开门后，引起了其中一人的注意。
“喂，你过来！”喊他的正是一位玄袍修士，这袍服是紫阳宗执法堂的典型装扮。
“不知师兄叫在下何事？”李卓阳走上前恭敬问道。
“十五日前，你在何处？”
李卓阳故意思索了一阵，然后道：“在下当日修炼不畅，闲来无事便去了一趟紫阳矿区，买了几十块矿石，可是一块也没中。”
当日他驾驭闪云梭前往矿区时，并未幻形，所以若有人在路上见过他，他也抵赖不了，此时不能冒险撒谎。
“哦？你可知田持弓师弟当日就死在矿区外数里。”
“什么？他死了？”李卓阳装作一脸震惊的模样！
“不瞒师兄，那田持弓一个月前曾堵在在下门前索要管理费，他仗着炼气七层的修为，差点将我这炼气四层的外门弟子打伤，若非有宗主座下弟子韩盈盈师妹相助，恐怕当日在下便得不了好。”
李卓阳大大方方地将二人的仇怨说了出来，并且顺带着强调了自己炼气四层的修为，又提了一嘴韩盈盈，透露自己上头也有人。
那执法弟子听后，果然仔细感应了李卓阳炼气四层的修为，然后想起韩盈盈的存在，便不再询问。
李卓阳避过此次询问后，心里长长舒了一口气，但表面上毫无波澜。
出了坊市，他更是直接朝功德殿走去，那田管事生前是这里的管事，如今也不知是何人负责。
进了功德殿，果然就见到了一位同样炼气九层的修士在任务玉板旁悬挂新的任务。
“这位师弟，可是前来接宗门任务？”那人见李卓阳走近，便主动开口询问道。
李卓阳本无意接任务，但此时否认，又恐遭人怀疑。
“是的，在下近期想获取一些功德殿，兑换功法。”
“那师弟来的正好，今日刚上了一批新的任务。”说完，他将身体从玉板前移开，让出上面悬挂的任务。
李卓阳见此，只好上前装作细细打量的样子。
“我上次前来，似乎不是师兄在此负责，敢问师兄贵姓？”
“我姓孙，之前负责此处的田师兄出了意外，我才接手不到十日。”
“有劳孙师兄了。”李卓阳听到此人与田家无关，悬着的心也落了下来，然后才真正地查看这些任务。
不过，这一看，倒让他看到了中意的任务。
“前往炼器坊做炼器学徒一个月，每日两个功德点。”
他如今正好想炼制一批紫阳剑，这种数量如果委托外人炼制的话，除了耗费灵石外，也会惹得有心之人怀疑，毕竟不是每个人都能一次拿出数十块紫阳石的。
“此项任务似乎挺轻松的。”李卓阳指着炼器坊任务与孙师兄道。
content_en:
As for the Ziyang Sword Technique, perhaps because he did not have the accompanying practice of the Ziyang Sword, he has not yet touched the threshold.
Working behind closed doors is never an option, it’s time to go out and take a look.
Moreover, the Tian family had considerable influence in the sect, so Li Zhuoyang also wanted to inquire about the Tian family's movements elsewhere to avoid being caught off guard.
Although he crushed their bones to ashes on the spot, due to his hurry that day, there were still many traces of the place where Tian Mochigong died. If the Tian family investigated carefully, they might be able to find some clues.
After leaving the grocery store, Li Zhuoyang found that there were far fewer people in the general market, and there were several inner disciples in black robes who were constantly looking at everyone in the market.
After Li Zhuoyang opened the door, he attracted the attention of one of them.
"Hey, come here!" The person who called him was a monk in black robe. This robe was the typical dress of the Ziyang Sect Law Enforcement Hall.
"I wonder what you are calling me for, senior brother?" Li Zhuoyang stepped forward and asked respectfully.
"Where were you fifteen days ago?"
Li Zhuoyang deliberately thought for a while, and then said: "I didn't practice well that day, so I went to the Ziyang Mining Area and bought dozens of ores, but I didn't hit any of them."
When he drove the Flash Cloud Shuttle to the mining area that day, he did not change his form, so if anyone saw him on the road, he could not deny it and could not risk lying at this time.
"Oh? Did you know that Junior Brother Tian Zhigong died a few miles outside the mining area that day?"
"What? He's dead?" Li Zhuoyang pretended to be shocked!
"To be honest, senior brother, Na Tian Zhi Gong blocked me in front of the lower gate a month ago and asked for management fees. He relied on his cultivation at the seventh level of Qi Refining and almost injured me, an outer disciple at the fourth level of Qi Refining. If it hadn't been for the help of Junior Sister Han Yingying, a disciple of the sect leader, I'm afraid I wouldn't have been able to do well that day."
Li Zhuoyang spoke openly about the grudge between the two, and along the way emphasized his cultivation at the fourth level of Qi Refining, and mentioned Han Yingying, revealing that there was someone above him.
After hearing this, the law enforcement disciple carefully sensed Li Zhuoyang's cultivation at the fourth level of Qi Refining. Then he remembered Han Yingying's existence and stopped asking.
After Li Zhuoyang avoided this inquiry, he breathed a long sigh of relief, but on the surface there was no disturbance.
After leaving Fangshi, he walked directly towards the Hall of Merit and Virtue. Steward Tian was the steward here during his lifetime, but now he doesn't know who is in charge.
Entering the Hall of Merit, I saw a monk who was also at the ninth level of Qi Refining hanging a new mission next to the mission jade board.
"Is this junior brother here to take over the sect's mission?" When the man saw Li Zhuoyang approaching, he took the initiative to ask.
Li Zhuoyang had no intention of taking on the mission, but if he denied it at this time, he was afraid of being suspected.
"Yes, I would like to obtain some Merit Palaces in the near future to redeem them for exercises."
"Junior brother came just in time. A new batch of tasks have just been assigned today." After saying that, he moved his body away from the jade board and gave way to the tasks hanging above.
Seeing this, Li Zhuoyang had no choice but to step forward and pretend to look at it carefully.
"Last time I came here, it seemed that my senior brother was not responsible here. May I ask your senior brother's name?"
"My surname is Sun. Senior Brother Tian who was in charge of this place had an accident and I took over the job less than ten days ago."
"Thank you, Senior Brother Sun." Li Zhuoyang's heart dropped when he heard that this person had nothing to do with the Tian family, and then he really checked these tasks.
However, this look made him see the mission he wanted.
"Go to the Weapon Refining Workshop to be a Weapon Refining Apprentice for one month, and get two merit points every day."
Now he just wants to refine a batch of Purple Sun Swords. If he entrusts an outsider to refine such a quantity, it will not only consume spiritual stones, but also arouse the suspicion of interested people. After all, not everyone can produce dozens of Purple Sun Stones at one time.
"This task seems quite easy." Li Zhuoyang pointed to the task of the weapon refining workshop and said to Senior Brother Sun.
